name: segmented-control
title: Segmented Control
description: Physical tactile well track with recessed depth, smooth spring sliding pill, and full keyboard accessibility.

props.name: options
props.description: Array of options with value, label, optional icon, and optional badge

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands options to fill available track width

examples.title: Tactile Track Mode Switcher
examples.description: Recessed track with sliding pill indicator and icon labels.
examples.code:
<SegmentedControl
  options={[
    { value: 'all', label: 'All Clusters' },
    { value: 'active', label: 'Active', badge: 12 },
    { value: 'standby', label: 'Standby', badge: 3 },
  ]}
  defaultValue="all"
/>
